package.name: l5_localization
package.description: L5 sim-in-loop localisation canaries (docs/notes/localization-2026-11-03.md, claude-docs/12-testing.md): racer_gym_bridge with its ground-truth TF off and the car's sensor shapes and noise, racer_bringup's mapping and localization launch files (racer_state's wheel_twist_node, robot_localization, slam_toolbox, nav2 AMCL), and racer_control's tracker_node. A mapping canary compares a saved slam_toolbox map with the sim's map; the localisation canaries drive laps on the AMCL pose and check its error against ground truth. No library code: test hosting only (see .github/scripts/l5_localization_test.sh).
